transcript: absolutely. I think that when we do talk about D. gendering acting awards, we should talk about what. what do those roles look like? I don't necessarily think that gendering acting awards is the solution to solving this problem, because again, that is the only award category that we do gender. but I do think that there's an interesting conversation to be had and who are people even writing for? now, I will say that before I show this to you, that one year is a lot more balanced than the other. but it's hard to form an opinion from just 2 years. we don't really have a full pattern out yet, but I do think it's interesting to look at. here are musicals and plays for this season. if you take a look at the musicals, the lead roles balance out to about 55% female. the plays, however, balance out to almost 75 male. now, I will say there's a lot of shows that we just don't know yet. I have posted a video of my proposed solution, which wouldn't be just to pick 2 winners of any gender, but to make new categories.
